interpretation_uncertainties: The canonicalization rules do not specify a unique lexical normalization for finite JSON numbers beyond deterministic JSON, compact separators, and finiteness. The implementation uses Python standard-library json.dumps numeric rendering and therefore rejects received numeric spellings that parse to the same value but differ from that rendering.

No cross-level implication between result-set execution.state and proposition execution states is stated beyond the completed-result-set non-empty rule and proposition-local conclusion rules. The implementation therefore permits a completed result set containing a failed or incomplete proposition if that proposition otherwise satisfies its local rules.

Contribution classification completeness is interpreted as a rule of a non-null conclusion. Failed or incomplete propositions, which are required to have conclusion:null, may therefore retain contributions (and a structurally/reference-valid measurement) without causal/residual classification.

Rule-role integrity is implemented in the stated direction: a rule-namespaced causal basis member must have a matching causal rule role, and a residual rule role must not be causal basis. The text does not state the converse, so a declared causal rule role need not itself appear in basis_members.

The supplied Contract-B index is external validation input rather than Contract-C wire data. Its displayed shape does not explicitly state unknown-field behavior; the implementation chooses a fail-closed exact-shape interpretation for the index and each passage entry.
